children: Raw sugar futures on ICE edged higher on Wednesday boosted partly by tight supplies in top consumer India, while arabica coffee prices also rose.

* BMI analysts also said in a note that any El Nino-linked production disruptions in India would have a greater impact than in previous cycles due to low stocks.
